decision: Neither candidate passes as a drop-in with the unchanged full primary prompt. No model selected; no production changes.
scoring_note: Missing/invalid rows count as wrong for every exact-agreement axis. The inherited exploratory scorer credits some absent rows as empty sets; this report recomputes exact metrics from the frozen reference and never uses those inflated percentages. Label F1 uses the original denominator and counts missing positives as false negatives. Array order is ignored for multi-label axes. Valid rows salvaged from invalid batches are diagnostic only.
limits: Consumed 45-case owner development reference; not unseen validation.
Current-v3 axes only; proposed Audience Topics and Geopolitical revisions are not measured.
One job positive, zero personnel positives, zero bug positives; those classes cannot be validated adequately here.
Single provider route per model, no model-specific prompt optimization; this does not establish that specialized shorter prompts will fail.
Failed calls and malformed outputs remain in cost and quality denominators.
DeepSeek dollars are current-rate repricing of recorded usage; OpenRouter dollars are reported billed cost, excluding credit-purchase fees.
Smoke overhead is separately shown; no semantic retries or repairs.
